title: Program
description: One public bug-bounty or vulnerability-disclosure program: one line of programs.jsonl.gz.

id.description: <source>:<slug>. Stable; owned by exactly one source adapter.

source.description: The adapter that produced the record (the id prefix).

platform.description: Where the program is hosted: "self-hosted" or the name of the hosting platform.

url.description: The program's policy page (http or https).

status.description: closed: the source no longer lists the program (kept 180 days, then dropped). paused: listed but not currently accepting (dead policy link, expired security.txt).

scope_published.description: True when the source carries the program's own structured scope. When false, in_scope holds at most inferred suggestions.

in_scope.description: Sorted by (type, value), no duplicates. Out of scope wins: a value listed in both appears only in out_of_scope.

rejected.description: Targets the program listed that the feed's scope rules refused, with the reason.

last_seen.description: Last run in which the source listed the program.

last_changed.description: Last run in which any content (not timestamps) changed.

closed_at.description: Present exactly when status is closed.

value.description: Canonical form: domain = lower-case A-label, not a public suffix, not a reserved name; wildcard = "*." + such a domain; ip = public unicast address; cidr = masked public prefix of at least /16 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6); url = http(s) without credentials or fragment, host checked as above.

confidence.description: published: the program's own scope. published_by_platform: scope the hosting platform published for the program, read through a public aggregate dataset; it states what the program lists and is never permission to test.inferred: derived by the collector (for example the host serving the program's security.txt); a suggestion, never an authorisation to test.

notes.description: The collector's remark about the target (for example why it is inferred).

asset_type.description: Schema 1.1. The platform's own asset type mapped to a normalised kind; finer than type. Absent when the source did not say.

ports.description: Schema 1.1. Ports or port ranges the scope is limited to, when the platform published them.

path_prefix.description: Schema 1.1. url targets only: the path the scope is limited to.

instructions.description: Schema 1.1. The platform's testing instructions for this asset.

requires.description: Schema 1.1. Headers, test accounts or other prerequisites the platform lists.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the terms document the collector read at fetched_at. Absent when the collector did not read the terms.

dataset.description: Aggregate dataset repository the record was read through (owner/name).

original_platform.description: The platform the dataset took the record from.

original_url.description: The program page on the original platform.
